svg.title: A cone-supported distribution annihilates Schwartz tests vanishing near the cone. For compact smooth g, the tests ηe−⟨Y,q⟩g and e−⟨Y,q⟩g agree near it, hence have equal readings. Compact support is essential to the second test. At strict temporal y, bounded continuous fv,y defines tempered uy. Apply (FT2) to e−⟨ey,q⟩g; exponentials cancel and cutoffremoval gives c Wv(Deyg) = buy(g). Schwartz continuity and compact cutoffs extend equality to all tests. Fourier inversion and (TL6) identify their smeared functions; continuity and full-support Lebesgue upgrade almost-everywhere to pointwise equality: Fv(X + iey) = fv,y(X). (TI1)
